title: Test worlds: run garbage collection after destroying them, so reserved GPU memory stops climbing during the test run
acceptance: A full ETM test run logs no LogRHICore 'exceeds the budget' warning
One shared test-world helper replaces the per-file copies
description: Seen from T-0021 on: around the 40th test world, LogRHICore warns that reserved resource virtual size (258 GB) exceeds its budget (256 GB). Each test file creates and destroys its own world; the cannon tests also never end play. Not a test failure and not seen in the game.
